cpu.artifact_cache: existing content-addressed CPU disk cache; GPU NVRTC compile included. First measured calls retained, no warmup samples discarded
cpu.baseline: current one-shot public API, including session-per-call GPU implementation; not the historical pre-session binary

execution.timing_scope: This call: source/IR/input validation, first-use compile/load when needed, packing, native-thread dispatch, exact runtime, collection and source checks; session construction and final close are separate and must be included in lifecycle benchmarks

cpu.timing_scope: same prepared18-transition conformance adapter, runtime construction, compile/cache lookup, first loads, execution, all original admissions, passive records, cleanup and full report serialization; shared initial fixture construction and later reference comparison excluded from both

gpu.artifact_cache: existing content-addressed CPU disk cache; GPU NVRTC compile included. First measured calls retained, no warmup samples discarded
gpu.baseline: current one-shot public API, including session-per-call GPU implementation; not the historical pre-session binary

execution.timing_scope: Per-call source/input validation, lowering, device preparation or reuse, transfers, kernel, synchronization, caller-context restoration and exact result/source bindings; session construction and final close are separate, no final report serialization.

gpu.timing_scope: same prepared18-transition conformance adapter, runtime construction, compile/cache lookup, first loads, execution, all original admissions, passive records, cleanup and full report serialization; shared initial fixture construction and later reference comparison excluded from both
